findings.reason: Confirmed at every point. (i) The accepted map's deduplicatedLinks[0] removes StablePeriodicCurved Layer 0 → QuiverRepresentations Layer 6 from links, with recordedIn research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_RepresentationTheory_QuiverRepresentations.json and the reason 'Same directed pair is present in the newer QuiverRepresentations packet'. That packet does carry the pair, but its status is 'partial', its review is null, and there is no data/links copy, so promote.py has never integrated it. By contrast, the other partner-hosted edge, SPC Layer 0 → ZigzagPreprojective Layer 2, comes from a map that is complete, accepted and promoted. (ii) Both preserved quotations are literal substrings of their stage descriptions and README files, with no whitespace normalisation needed: SPC Layer 0 ('For a class `P` of objects, define the ideal generated by maps `X → Q → Y` with `P(Q)`. …') and Quiver Layer 6 ('it is well-defined only up to projectives, through minimal presentations and duality on finite-dimensional modules, so 6B-6D are prerequisites.'). The consumer uses exactly what the supplier builds, the quotient of a module category by the ideal of maps factoring through projectives, so the inferred confidence is right. (iii) scripts.build.assemble(require_distances=False) at 5c9c171a gives 2840 stages and 8007 edges. All six active SPC links and SPC.0 → Zigzag.2 are present. SPC.0 → Quiver.6 is absent, and there is no path in either direction, so restoring it is acyclic. (iv) A scratch copy of the map with the preserved entry restored as an inferred link passes check_links.py with 0 errors and 0 warnings (7 links, 4 overlaps). The fix is right, including its scope limits: no self-injectivity or Happel triangulation, and the opposite-module adapter kept. This is the same failure mode, a deduplication against an unpromoted host, that I found independently on the AlgebraicCurves/ModularCurves pair (RT-LINK-tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_AlgebraicCurves/1). A deduplication entry should be accepted only when its host has been promoted. Medium is appropriate.
